instructions:
1. Start on hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
2. Step both feet back to extend your legs, coming onto the balls of your feet.
3. Form a straight line from head to heels with shoulders stacked over wrists.
4. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to stop your hips sagging or rising.
5. Hold the position with steady breathing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced the whole time to prevent the lower back from sagging.
2. Stack your shoulders directly over your wrists to spread the load evenly.
3. Keep your neck neutral by looking at the floor just ahead of your hands.
4. Breathe steadily instead of holding your breath.
name: High plank

instructions:
1. Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point.
2. Kneel facing away from the anchor and hold a handle in each hand near your head, elbows bent.
3. Keep your hips fixed and crunch your torso down toward your knees.
4. Pull your elbows toward your thighs by rounding your spine, not bending your hips.
5. Slowly return to the start while keeping tension on the band.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Curl the spine to bring the ribs toward the pelvis rather than folding at the hips.
2. Keep your hips stationary and avoid using momentum.
3. Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return.
4. Keep tension on the band throughout the range.
name: High Resistance band kneeling crunch

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with legs extended and arms reaching overhead.
2. Press your lower back flat into the floor.
3. Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor at the same time to form a shallow curve.
4. Brace your core and keep your lower back pinned to the floor.
5. Hold the position with steady breathing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the lower back flat against the floor; lift the legs less if it arches.
2. Lift shoulders and legs to a matching height for a balanced curve.
3. Bend the knees or lower the arms to make the hold easier.
4. Keep the neck relaxed and in line with the spine.
name: Hollow hold

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench at about 30 degrees between two cable stations with the pulleys low.
2. Grab a handle in each hand and lie back with feet flat on the floor.
3. Hold the handles out to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Sweep the handles up and together in a wide arc until they meet over your upper chest.
5. Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles back along the same arc with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a fixed slight bend in your elbows so it stays a fly, not a press.
2. Drive the movement with your chest by bringing the upper arms together.
3. Keep your back and head pressed against the bench.
4. Exhale as you bring the handles up and inhale as you lower them.
name: Incline bench cable fly

instructions:
1. Stand facing a bench and place your hands on its edge close together so thumbs and index fingers form a diamond.
2. Step your feet back to extend your legs and form a straight line from head to heels.
3. Brace your core to keep your body rigid.
4. Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward your hands, keeping elbows close to your body.
5. Push through your hands to extend your arms back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows tucked close to your body to load the triceps.
2. Move with control on the way down to keep tension on the muscles.
3. Keep your hips in line with your shoulders; do not let them sag.
4. Use a stable, non-slip bench so your hands do not move.
name: Incline diamond push up on bench
